title: Remove unrelated X.Org libGLX CPE from libglx
author: traversaro
source: Follow-up to https://github.com/prefix-dev/purl-associator/pull/344. The CPE cpe:2.3:a:x:libglx identifies the X.Org libGLX library (https://nvd.nist.gov/products/cpe/detail/0B6F2F6E-C152-402A-A15A-C3E6DB106CC1), which is distinct from the libglvnd library packaged by conda-forge as libglx. Clear the unrelated CPE only; retain all PURL fields and alternatives.
